232          val quote = ContextCompat.getDrawable(this, R.drawable.dynamic_bg_element)?.mutate()

234              text = content,
235              textWidthPx = column,
236              largeTextPx = sp(LARGE_TEXT_SP),
237              smallTextPx = sp(SMALL_TEXT_SP),
238              paddingPx = padding,
239              quote = quote,

245              canvasWidthPx = canvasWidth,
246              canvasHeightPx = canvasHeight,
247          )

222      /** 文字先落成本地图再进编辑器，不在这一步上传。表情用原 Spannable，避免只画出 [dxmm_xx]。本地出图不是耗时操作，不盖加载层。 */
223      private fun generateAndOpen() {
224          val content = binding.dynamicInput.text ?: return
225          if (content.toString().trim().isEmpty()) return
226          collapseInput()
227          val padding = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_32)
228          val canvasWidth = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_1) * CARD_WIDTH_DP
229          val canvasHeight = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_1) * CARD_HEIGHT_DP
230          val column = (canvasWidth - padding * 2).coerceAtLeast(1)
231          // 成图用资源库原色引号。输入框白底上的引号仍单独着 n_3。
232          val quote = ContextCompat.getDrawable(this, R.drawable.dynamic_bg_element)?.mutate()
233          val bitmap = DynamicTextImage.render(
234              text = content,
235              textWidthPx = column,
236              largeTextPx = sp(LARGE_TEXT_SP),
237              smallTextPx = sp(SMALL_TEXT_SP),
238              paddingPx = padding,
239              quote = quote,
240              quoteWidthPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_50),
241              quoteHeightPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_48),
242              quoteMarginEndPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_20),
243              quoteMarginBottomPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_40),
244              backgroundColor = ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.color_D4DFFB),
245              canvasWidthPx = canvasWidth,
246              canvasHeightPx = canvasHeight,
247          )
248          val file = File(cacheDir, "dynamic-text-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg")
249          FileOutputStream(file).use { output ->
250              bitmap.compress(android.graphics.Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, output)
251          }
252          bitmap.recycle()
253          openEditor(arrayOf(file.absolutePath), useOrigin = true, title = DynamicTextImage.titleOf(content.toString()))

222      /** 文字先落成本地图再进编辑器，不在这一步上传。表情用原 Spannable，避免只画出 [dxmm_xx]。本地出图不是耗时操作，不盖加载层。 */
223      private fun generateAndOpen() {
224          val content = binding.dynamicInput.text ?: return
225          if (content.toString().trim().isEmpty()) return
226          collapseInput()
227          val padding = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_32)
228          val canvasWidth = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_1) * CARD_WIDTH_DP
229          val canvasHeight = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_1) * CARD_HEIGHT_DP
230          val column = (canvasWidth - padding * 2).coerceAtLeast(1)
231          // 成图用资源库原色引号。输入框白底上的引号仍单独着 n_3。
232          val quote = ContextCompat.getDrawable(this, R.drawable.dynamic_bg_element)?.mutate()
233          val bitmap = DynamicTextImage.render(
234              text = content,
235              textWidthPx = column,
236              largeTextPx = sp(LARGE_TEXT_SP),
237              smallTextPx = sp(SMALL_TEXT_SP),
238              paddingPx = padding,
239              quote = quote,
240              quoteWidthPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_50),
241              quoteHeightPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_48),
242              quoteMarginEndPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_20),
243              quoteMarginBottomPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_40),
244              backgroundColor = ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.color_D4DFFB),
245              canvasWidthPx = canvasWidth,
246              canvasHeightPx = canvasHeight,
247          )
248          val file = File(cacheDir, "dynamic-text-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg")
249          FileOutputStream(file).use { output ->
250              bitmap.compress(android.graphics.Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, output)
251          }
252          bitmap.recycle()
253          openEditor(arrayOf(file.absolutePath), useOrigin = true, title = DynamicTextImage.titleOf(content.toString()))

223      private fun generateAndOpen() {
224          val content = binding.dynamicInput.text ?: return
225          if (content.toString().trim().isEmpty()) return
226          collapseInput()
227          val padding = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_32)
228          val canvasWidth = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_1) * CARD_WIDTH_DP
229          val canvasHeight = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_1) * CARD_HEIGHT_DP
230          val column = (canvasWidth - padding * 2).coerceAtLeast(1)
231          // 成图用资源库原色引号。输入框白底上的引号仍单独着 n_3。
232          val quote = ContextCompat.getDrawable(this, R.drawable.dynamic_bg_element)?.mutate()
233          val bitmap = DynamicTextImage.render(
234              text = content,
235              textWidthPx = column,
236              largeTextPx = sp(LARGE_TEXT_SP),
237              smallTextPx = sp(SMALL_TEXT_SP),
238              paddingPx = padding,
239              quote = quote,
240              quoteWidthPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_50),
241              quoteHeightPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_48),
242              quoteMarginEndPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_20),
243              quoteMarginBottomPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_40),
244              backgroundColor = ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.color_D4DFFB),
245              canvasWidthPx = canvasWidth,
246              canvasHeightPx = canvasHeight,
247          )
248          val file = File(cacheDir, "dynamic-text-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg")
249          FileOutputStream(file).use { output ->
250              bitmap.compress(android.graphics.Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, output)
251          }
252          bitmap.recycle()
253          openEditor(arrayOf(file.absolutePath), useOrigin = true, title = DynamicTextImage.titleOf(content.toString()))

222      /** 文字先落成本地图再进编辑器，不在这一步上传。表情用原 Spannable，避免只画出 [dxmm_xx]。本地出图不是耗时操作，不盖加载层。 */
223      private fun generateAndOpen() {
224          val content = binding.dynamicInput.text ?: return
225          if (content.toString().trim().isEmpty()) return
226          collapseInput()
227          val padding = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_32)
228          val canvasWidth = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_1) * CARD_WIDTH_DP
229          val canvasHeight = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_1) * CARD_HEIGHT_DP
230          val column = (canvasWidth - padding * 2).coerceAtLeast(1)
231          // 成图用资源库原色引号。输入框白底上的引号仍单独着 n_3。
232          val quote = ContextCompat.getDrawable(this, R.drawable.dynamic_bg_element)?.mutate()
233          val bitmap = DynamicTextImage.render(
234              text = content,
235              textWidthPx = column,
236              largeTextPx = sp(LARGE_TEXT_SP),
237              smallTextPx = sp(SMALL_TEXT_SP),
238              paddingPx = padding,
239              quote = quote,
240              quoteWidthPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_50),
241              quoteHeightPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_48),
242              quoteMarginEndPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_20),
243              quoteMarginBottomPx = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.ndp_40),
244              backgroundColor = ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.color_D4DFFB),
245              canvasWidthPx = canvasWidth,
246              canvasHeightPx = canvasHeight,
247          )
248          val file = File(cacheDir, "dynamic-text-${System.currentTimeMillis()}.jpg")
249          FileOutputStream(file).use { output ->
250              bitmap.compress(android.graphics.Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, output)
251          }
252          bitmap.recycle()
253          openEditor(arrayOf(file.absolutePath), useOrigin = true, title = DynamicTextImage.titleOf(content.toString()))
